g.text: Hey Aoi? Do you have a second? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.
It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.
Nothing! Nothing. I just wanted to talk to you about something that I hope isn't an uncomfortable situation for you.
I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
i guess i just wanna know if i get 2 meet them or not?
oh... its not like... it's not 1 of the hex, is it? or one of the roundtable? that might get a little ick
No, you wouldn't know them. And sadly I don't know if I can arrange a meeting. They're not from this time.
daangit!! well u have 2 promise me 2 have double the fun then on my account lol
but do they make u happy?
They do. And I don't care about you any less. You're both important to me.
then thats all i care about!
as long as we're all on the same page and every1 is happy with it, then i'm happy with it.
